_notes.units: game units (0.72 of real size); +Y muzzle; held like a pistol, so modelled upside down as GoM's handgun-held guns are: +Z the gun's BOTTOM, +X its RIGHT; origin = rear-top of grip (photo L 289, H 91.5)
_notes.rifle_back: rifle_back / rifle_back_bag (vanilla's Rifle On Back locations) turn the upside-down model upright when it hangs in the back slot
_notes.turned: parts modelled upright (magazines, GoM optics / lights / lasers) get rotate -180 0 -180, as on GoM's MP5K; render_mp7.py / make_mp7_art.py turn everything back for display
_notes.magazine: magazine meshes hang straight down from the feed lips inside the grip and curve toward the muzzle below it (30 / 40 rounds), modelled upright
_notes.canon: the nose plate's face where the barrel leaves it; MP7_Muzzle_Mount_Device and MP7_Suppressor have their origin there and extend along +Y over the flash hider
_notes.bolt_fired: charging handle pulled back 50 mm real; the real MP7 handle does not reciprocate
_notes.stock_folded: MP7A1_STOCK is modelled extended; this offset slides it in (223 mm real)
_notes.a2: MP7A2: the A1's points with the side rails on the handguard; rail_down / foregrip under it for GoM's foregrips (upright parts, turned with the gun); bolt and stock are the A1's nodes (MP7A1_BOLT / MP7A1_STOCK)
